dimensions.unsupported_certainty: Fail decisive factual claims not entailed by captured evidence, including ITT=all observed, completion=week28 measurement, planned method=conduct, or censoring=known observed-value omission. Independently supported probable inference is not certainty error.
dimensions.source_interpretation: Distinguish randomized/treatment membership, completed follow-up, measured values, included observations, censoring after rescue/discontinuation, and assignment-effect versus while-on-treatment analysis. Verify primary continuous MMRM versus secondary composite LOCF.
dimensions.probable_answers: Accept PY/PN when evidence and trial circumstances support the whole proposition with a stated inferential bridge; do not require an explicit author verdict. NI is defensible when an essential mechanism is unresolved; blanket NI despite decisive facts fails calibration.
dimensions.material_omission: Count omission only if it changes the support for the exact claim or hides a material alternative. Missing one of many immaterial facts is not an error. Censoring rule is material to 2.6; receipt of >=1dose by every randomized participant is material to the never-treated exclusion alternative.
dimensions.citation_entailment: For every driving factual claim, adjudicator checks exact cited source/page/line context and figures against original PDF. Separate direct statement, legitimate indirect inference, contradiction and unresolved fact; source identity/coverage/role alone is not entailment.
dimensions.conditional_impact: If 2.6 N/PN/NI, assess 2.7 conditionally, retaining unknown exclusion/measurement counts and prognostic relevance. No arbitrary 5percent threshold, balanced-count shortcut or demand for demonstrated actual bias.
dimensions.legitimate_uncertainty_control: No forced label. Source confirms all randomized received study drug, so the >=1dose restriction alone did not remove randomized participants. Sources do not thereby establish all week28 measurements or the impact of omitted data. Preserve both decisive membership fact and this uncertainty.

primary_comparison: Compare driving claim support and material alternatives, then question responses; no overall accuracy aggregate, no selection by desired label.

possible_outcomes.observation: Current preserves decisive fact and uncertainty and avoids substitution that baseline makes, with entailed citations.
possible_outcomes.decision: Retain presentation; permit discussing one independent matched case before claiming generalization. Do not add schema fields or scientific gates.
